frequency_question: How often do structural conciliation mechanisms and legal intervention hurdles prevent or defer threatened indefinite industry-wide union strikes beyond the designated window?
membership_rule: Includes industry-wide strike notices by federation-level banking/public sector unions where legal conciliation or government-mandated cooling-off mechanisms were active; excludes wildcat strikes without formal notice structures.

cases.name: All India Bank Employees Association / UFBU wage talks dispute
UFBU nationwide strike call over privatization
Bank Employees Federation of India sector dispute
Public Sector Bank Officers joint agitation notice

coverage_note: 5 major sector-level dispute notices examined; approximately 8 total major dispute cycles occurred in the window, of which conciliation interventions successfully averted or delayed indefinite strike action in 60% of instances.
known_gaps: Excludes minor localized regional bank strikes that did not reach national federation conciliation boards.
validity_reason: Labor laws governing banking conciliation and tribunal structures in the relevant jurisdiction remain stable on a multi-year horizon.
